description: Net AC capacity factor of utility-scale PV
source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition: slide 39, fleet 'cumulative net capacity factor ... is 23% but ranges from 6% to 40%'; slide 8, first-year capacity factor of 2024 plants rose 'from an average of 24% to 25%'.

description: Net capacity factor of land-based wind
source: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 7: 'The average capacity factor in 2023 was 33.5% on a fleet-wide basis and 38.2% among wind plants built in 2022.'

description: Revenue of a 4-hour battery per kW of power per month
source: Assumption. No published tolling or capacity price was found. Revenue is set equal to Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026) unsubsidized levelized cost of 4-hour storage, $266-369 per kW-year (about $22-31 per kW-month): the revenue at which the project recovers its costs.

description: Total capital cost of a 4-hour utility-scale battery per MW of power
source: Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026, LCOS v11.0), 4-hour utility-scale storage: 'Total Capital Cost $/kWh $270 - $365' (including inverter), times 4 hours. NLR 2025 ATB gives $1,449/kW for 2024, inside the range.

description: Installed cost of utility-scale PV per MW (AC), projects reaching commercial operation in 2025, 2025 dollars
source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 31: 'Capacity-weighted means ... increased from $1.65/WAC in 2024 to $1.69/WAC in 2025. Medians ... increased from $1.74/WAC in 2024 to $1.77/WAC in 2025.' Low is the capacity-weighted mean, high the median. PV only; 2025 figures are preliminary. By size, slide 33 runs from $1.53/WAC (over 250 MW) to $2.10/WAC (under 20 MW).

description: Installed cost of land-based wind per MW
source: Low: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, executive summary p. 8: installed costs 'since 2018, have largely held steady at ~$1,700/MW [per kW] on a capacity-weighted average basis' (2023 dollars; regional averages as low as $1,320/kW in SPP). High: NLR (formerly NREL) 2025 Electricity ATB workbook, land-based wind CAPEX $1,920/kW for 2024 (2023 dollars, Moderate scenario), https://data.openei.org/files/8759/2025_v1_Workbook_08-27-2026.xlsx. The LBNL 2025 and 2026 wind editions could not be opened on 2026-11-05; read the 2026 edition before relying on this range.

description: Cost of capital (nominal), used to discount the deferred net revenue stream
source: Assumption. Low: NLR 2025 ATB nominal WACC without tax credits, 5.63% for utility PV and 5.74% for land-based wind (Moderate, WACC Calc sheet). High: Hawthorn's allowance for merchant and storage risk; Lazard's storage case assumes 20% debt at 8% and 80% equity at 12%, about 11%.

description: Annual change in the installed cost of utility-scale battery storage, real dollars
source: Assumption. No source gives a year-over-year change in standalone storage capex. The high end is LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 12: 'Costs of PV+battery projects increased 4% to $2.7/WAC-PV in 2025.'

description: Annual change in the installed cost of utility-scale PV, real dollars
source: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 7: installed costs of new PV were '$1.7/WAC ... 2% higher than in 2024'; the median rose from $1.74 to $1.77/WAC (1.7%, slide 31). A change in real dollars: nominal escalation is higher by the rate of inflation.

description: Annual change in the installed cost of land-based wind, real dollars
source: Assumption. LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 8, says installed cost has 'largely held steady' since 2018 (low end 0); the high end is the solar figure, since no wind source gives one.

description: Clean electricity investment credit (48E) as a share of qualified investment, prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements met, before bonus adders
source: 26 U.S.C. 48E(a)(2): the applicable percentage is 6 percent, or 30 percent when the prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements are met. Applied to the full per-MW capital cost, so it is an upper bound where qualified investment is smaller than installed cost; the energy community and domestic content adders are not included.

description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of a 4-hour battery per kW of power
source: Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026), 4-hour storage O&M $3.75-7.75 per kWh-year, times 4 hours. Lazard's figures, to match the revenue assumption taken from its levelized cost. NLR 2025 ATB puts fixed O&M at about $50/kW-year, including battery augmentation.

description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of utility-scale PV
source: Low: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 36, O&M costs 'about $11/kWAC-year' (FERC Form 1 scope, without property tax, insurance or land). High: NLR 2025 ATB utility-scale PV page, '$24.66/kW AC-yr for 2024', https://atb.nlr.gov/electricity/2025/utility-scale_pv.

description: Fixed operation and maintenance cost of land-based wind
source: NLR 2025 Electricity ATB workbook, land-based wind fixed O&M: $43.0/kW-year (2023 base year) and $41.9/kW-year (2024), 2023 dollars, Moderate scenario.

description: Power purchase agreement price for utility-scale solar
source: Low: LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 10, average levelized PPA price of 2025-COD projects, $34/MWh (25th to 75th percentile $27-47; contracts signed 1.5 to 4 years before operation). High: LevelTen North American PPA Price Index Q3 2026: 'Core-Markets P25 Solar Price ... rests at $64.23/MWh' (offers, not signed contracts), https://www.leveltenenergy.com/post/levelten-north-american-ppa-price-index-q3-2026.

description: Power purchase agreement price for land-based wind
source: Low: LBNL Land-Based Wind Market Report 2024 Edition, p. 8, recent levelized PPA prices '~$25/MWh' in the Central and West regions (2021-22 contracts; '~$45/MWh' in the East). High: LevelTen North American PPA Price Index Q3 2026: 'Core-Markets P25 Wind Price for Q3 came in at $68.27/MWh' (offers), https://www.leveltenenergy.com/post/levelten-north-american-ppa-price-index-q3-2026.

description: Development spending before construction (engineering, permits, interconnection studies, land and community outreach) as a share of installed cost
source: Assumption, taken from NREL/NLR Q1 2024 Solar Cost Benchmarks (PVSCM 2024, file 'UPV 2024Q1.txt'): 'Officework' (engineering, permits, interconnection, land outreach) of $32-69 per kWdc against a total of $1,021-1,212 per kWdc for a 100 MWdc single-axis project, 2.6% to 6.8%. Applied to wind and storage as well; network upgrade deposits are not in it.

description: Operating life of a utility-scale battery
source: NLR 2025 ATB utility-scale battery storage: '15-year lifetime' (low), https://atb.nlr.gov/electricity/2025/utility-scale_battery_storage. Lazard LCOE+ (July 2026): 'Project Life ... 20' years (high).

description: Operating life of a utility-scale PV project
source: NLR 2025 ATB, financial cases and methods: cost recovery period '30 years for all technologies' (low). LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2026 Edition, slide 45: 'Project design life increases from 21.5 years in 2007 to 35 years in 2021 and thereafter' (high).

description: Operating life of a land-based wind project
source: NLR 2025 ATB, land-based wind and financial cases and methods: technical life and cost recovery period of 30 years.
